Buffer.fromUTF8: Create a new buffer from an UTF8-encoded string
Buffer.toString: Convert a buffer to string assuming UTF8 encoding
butiaV2.motorStopSingle: Stops a single motor, leaving the other running.
butiaV2.motorTank: Sets each motor's speed independently (tank drive).
butiaV2.moveBackward: Drives both motors backward. Runs indefinitely, or for the given duration if set.
butiaV2.moveForward: Drives both motors forward. Runs indefinitely, or for the given duration if set.
butiaV2.obstacleDistance: Reads the distance sensor on the given connector, in cm.
butiaV2.onButton: Runs the handler when the button on the given connector reaches the given state, at the given priority.
butiaV2.onDistance: Runs the handler when the distance sensor on the given connector matches the comparison, at the given priority.
butiaV2.onGray: Runs the handler when the gray sensor on the given connector matches the comparison, at the given priority.
butiaV2.onLight: Runs the handler when the light sensor on the given connector matches the comparison, at the given priority.
butiaV2.readButton: Whether the button on the given connector is currently pressed.
butiaV2.readGenericSensor: Reads a generic analog sensor. Pick an existing name or create one from the dropdown.
butiaV2.readGraySensor: Reads the analog gray/line sensor on the given connector (0-100, higher = darker).
butiaV2.readLightSensor: Reads the light sensor on the given connector (0-100).
butiaV2.selectMap:
Selects which botsim map to run against. The robot itself starts
automatically the first time any other Butia v2 block runs — no
separate "start" block is needed.
butiaV2.servoSetAngle: Sets a servo's angle on the given connector.
butiaV2.turn: Turns in place toward the given direction.
